worldcombat.skill.razorwind.summary: Plant your feet and twist the air around you into blades of wind, then release the whole fan forward: every foe the fan covers takes one wind blade, cutting several in one sweep. The charge can be interrupted - the price of the two-turn attack - and it lands critical hits more often.
Each wind blade deals %1$s special damage to foes in the fan and lands critical hits more often.
The fan reaches %1$s blocks forward and spreads %2$s degrees to each side, cutting up to %3$s targets at once.
It takes %1$s of standing still to gather the wind.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.stance.sprea: Scattershot form: a wider fan and more blades, at slightly lower per-blade power and reach.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.stance.focus: Focused form: higher power and longer reach, at a narrower fan.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s charge, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.growth.0: From level %1$s the wind blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.growth.1: From level %1$s the wind blade rises to %2$s, reach extends to %3$s blocks and the fan opens to %4$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.use.0: Plant your feet and twist the air into blades
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.use.1: Release the gathered blades as a forward fan
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.use.2: Sweep a rank of foes with a raised critical chance
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.preference.s: On (scattershot): fan half-angle x1.4 and blades x1.5, at 85% power and 90% range - for sweeping a rank. Off (focused): 112% power and 112% range, at a fan narrowed to x0.7 - for cutting fewer targets harder.
worldcombat.skill.razorwind.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of gathering; larger values open the fan from further out.
Inside this distance it lowers the move's priority and backs off before charging; 0 charges even at point-blank.
On: more foes inside the forward fan makes the move rank higher, since one sweep can cut them all. Off: it ranks as an ordinary ranged attack.
